Themes shipped by mariner

Source: R/mariner-package.R
mariner_themes.Rd

The brand identities available to mariner_setup_project() and the templates. Every function that takes a theme argument validates against this vector.

Usage

mariner_themes

Format

A character vector.

Details

There is one theme today. It stays a vector, and theme stays a named argument everywhere rather than being dropped, so adding a second identity later is a new entry here rather than a signature change across the package.
